coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 9 ground-truth variable items (33%): target properties (p-logP, QED, binding affinity), model configurations at the conceptual level (pretrained prior, feedback-finetuned models, baseline), and structural diversity measurements including long carbon chains.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Replaces MOLGEN with REINVENT and ESR1/ACAA1 with DRD2/JNK3/GSK3β. Omits the fixed pipeline scripts, constant DeepSpeed setup, and synthetic versus natural-product domain comparison. Reports general property metrics rather than top-three scores and omits the specified ESR1/ACAA1 binding-affinity improvements.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing the expected MOLGEN findings: p-logP up to 80.30, maintained or improved QED, lower KD with approximately 96.7% ESR1 and 70.4% ACAA1 improvements, reduced molecular hallucinations, and maintained diversity.
